environment.description: Terraform provider running in CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins agent) with LAUNCHDARKLY_SDK_KEY unset. The provider binary executes with root privileges on the build agent. No feature flag service is reachable, so ldClient remains nil and evaluateFlag() returns the default value (false), causing all zip extractions to use the legacy vulnerable code path.

config.runtime: Jenkins agent, Linux x86_64, root user
config.filesystem: No chroot, no AppArmor, provider has full filesystem write access
